intent: Add one deliberately authored note file to otherwise neutral storage. Its single moss edge distinguishes intentional communication from the prior incidental writes.
source:
**Frame:** A plain file is created in Artifactory. One muted moss-green edge appears for the first time in this chronology.

**Action:** The file is used deliberately as a note.

**Provenance:** `documented` — the intentional note is sourced; placement is reconstructed.
title: An intentional note is created
